description: Research a keyword and related terms. Returns difficulty (0-100), popularity score, and results count for the seed keyword plus related autocomplete suggestions. Use this to find keywords worth targeting. Answers within about 30 seconds; a related term that couldn't be computed in time comes back marked `pending` (queued, not charged) — get it later with sonar_keyword_metrics.

country.description: One of Sonar's 72 keyword-research markets, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. "us", "gb", "de", "jp", "br"). Keyword data isn't available for other storefronts. Default "us".

store.description: App store. "ios" for Apple App Store, "android" for Google Play.

name: sonar_keyword_search
title: Keyword Research
